html:
Unique Research · Company / Funding · May 18, 2022

On May 16, 2022, ParTech unicorn Impact (founded 2008; China team since 2019) closed a $100M equity round from W Capital and Providence Public — 6th round (after $150M Jul’21 from QIA + Providence) — for global expansion, product matrix, and R&D. Impact Partnership Cloud: partner discovery → recruit → contract → anti-fraud → optimize → pay across the full partner lifecycle for marketers.

— END —
